info.autofish.open_water_detection.fail: §c[Autofish] The fish float was not in open water!§0
info.autofish.open_water_detection.succe: §a[Autofish] The fish float was in open water!§0
options.autofish.open_water_detection.to:
After 20w12a (1.16), you can only get
treasure items in open water.
This will let you know when your float
is not in open water upon reeling-in.
options.autofish.persistent.tooltip:
Keep the fish hook always in liquid
whenever a rod is in hand, recast when
needed. This is useful for lag issues or
fishing for long periods of time.
options.autofish.sound.tooltip:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based on
float sounds rather than the standard
float movement detection.§r
§f- You must be close to your float.
- If other players' floats are close by,
  it can falsely trigger a catch!
options.autofish.open_water_new_algorith:
§6New implementation more closely
following the documented open water
validation process on §eMinecraft Wiki§6.§r

§fAffects fish float block test as well.
Turn off to restore legacy behaviour.
options.autofish.legacy_persistence.tool:
§6Instead of using the newer state-aware
algorithm, switch back to the legacy
§ePersistent Mode§6 implementation.§r

§aNew§f: Gathers various states, counts time
durations, and reels-in accordingly.
§cOld§f: Scans every §e10§f seconds, and reels if
the float isn't in fishable liquid at that
instant.
options.autofish.random_delay.title: Recast Delay Randomisation Range
options.autofish.random_delay.tooltip:
Introduces constrained randomness in
either direction to §eRecast Delay§f.
For example, if the base value is set to
1500 ms, setting the randomisation range
to 20% will make the value vary between
1200 ms and 1800 ms.
To disable randomisation, set this to 0.
